Sealed quotations are invited for the supply of MS / SS Materials as per the description/
specification detailed in the Annexure and as per the terms and conditions mentioned therein.
Terms and conditions:
1. The rate quoted should be firm and inclusive of all taxes and other charges as admissible.
Dt. .01..2026.
03.02. 202
2. The materials should be directly supplied to the PPCL site, T.R. Pattinam, Karaikal - 609 606,
on door delivery basis.
3. Payment will be made within 30 days from the date of receipt of your invoice after receipt
of materials in good condition. The bill in triplicate along with advance stamped receipt
should be sent to the undersigned for effecting payment.
Nopayment will be made against document through bank.
5. Part payment will not be accepted for the supply of ordered items.
6. EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT: An Earnest Money Deposit of Rs.4,500/- (Rupees four
thousand and five hundred only) should be paid by demand draft drawn in favour of the
Executive Engineer (Mech)-Plant, Puducherry Power Corporation Ltd T.R. Pattinam, Karaikal
on any Nationalized/Scheduled bank payable at Karaikal. The same should be enclosed along
with tender/quotation. The earnest money deposit will bear no interest and will be released
after successful completion of the supply and acceptance. The EMD will be returned to
unsuccessful bidder on receipt of a letter requesting for the same after placement of order to
the successful bidder.

7. PSU & Parties registered with NSIÇ/SSI/MSME are exempted for submitting EMD/SD.
However copies of supporting Documents/Certificates should be kept in separate cover
super scribing "Earnest Money Deposit Exemption".
8. The party shall be required to place the earnest money and the tender in separate sealed
envelopes marked "Earnest Money" and "Tender" respectively. Both the envelopes shall then
be placed in another sealed envelope and submitted to the tender inviting authority in the
usual manner. The officer opening the tenders shall first open the envelope containing the
earnest money. If the earnest money is found to be in order, only then the Officer shall proceed
further with opening the tender.
9. The delivery period and mode of despatch should be clearly specified.
10. L.D CLAUSE: LD shall be applicable @½ % (Half) per week subject to a maximum of 5% (Five)
of the undelivered portion of the total order value in case of delay in supply of undelivered
portion of the material.
11. Order will be placed to the tenderer on individual item basis for which the tenderer had
quoted the least rate.
12. Validity: Your offer should be valid for 90 days from the date of opening of tender.
13. Our GSTIN No.: 34AAACP6507E1ZS are registered with Commercial Taxes Department,
Puducherry.
14. Any loss or damage during transit to site should be made good by the supplier free of charge
provided the same is reported within 15 days of the arrival of material at site.
15. Sealed quotations should be super scribed as "QUOTATION/ENQUIRY NO. AC-086 for
the supply of MS /SS Materials ", due on 23.02.2026.
16. If the tender opening date happens to be a holiday, the tender will be opened on the next
working day.
17. Applicable taxes, freight and other charges should be clearly mentioned as whether inclusive or
extra. If not mentioned, it will be presumed that the rate quoted is inclusive of all taxes and
other charges.
18. The undersigned reserves all rights to accept/reject any or all the quotations without assigning
any reasons thereof.
